author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want a second monitor without buying extra hardware? In this video, I’ll show you how to turn your laptop into a second screen using built-in Windows features — no software required.

You’ll also learn an alternative method that works on almost any setup, including tablets and different devices, using a free tool.

By the end, you’ll know how to:
- Extend your display across two laptops 
- Duplicate or extend your screen 
- Adjust monitor positioning for a seamless workflow 
- Fix compatibility issues with an alternative method 
- Improve performance with wired connections 

This is perfect if you want more screen space for multitasking, productivity, or working on multiple apps at once.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Windows + I to open Windows settings
- Windows + K to open cast settings

title: Use Your Laptop as a Second Monitor (No Software Needed)

author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Use your laptop as a second screen in Windows — completely free and built in.

Steps:
1. On your laptop: Settings → System → Projecting to this PC
2. Install “Wireless Display” if needed
3. On your main PC: press Windows + K
4. Select your laptop
5. Switch to Extend in Display settings

💡 Works great for multitasking, travel setups, or extra screen space without buying another monitor.
